H1_seed_disentanglement.reason: P3 seed averaging gains 0.00446 over the best member, but the algebraic seed-variance share is only 7.7% of consensus MSE; error rankings are shared across families (signed-error correlation 0.86-0.93). Seed noise changes the level a little, not the hard-core membership.

H2_label_structure_coverage.reason: J exact typed-path content covers 99.6% of valid path occurrences but J is 0.00355 worse than P3B, which argues against a simple global-label-shortage explanation. It does not rule out finite supervision/compositional support: only molecule-level y exists, no per-pattern labels, and 25.1% of valid molecules contain an unseen radius-2 environment. Sample/structure support remains an open explanation.

H3_readout_interface_dilution.reason: P3 Null grouping replaces local junction identity with n_b * graph_mean(w), and the error is concentrated in rare local environments. This is a coherent interface hypothesis, but the audit evidence is not causal: freezing P3B and swapping grouping to organized degrades valid MAE from 0.0762 to 0.1213, which only shows an untrained replacement is bad and cannot prove a parallel channel helps. The dual-channel L-C contrast is the pre-registered test.

H4_target_tail.reason: y<=-3 is 6.5% of rows but 16.2% of absolute error; the radius-2 effect survives within y>-3 (0.134 vs 0.048), so the tail contributes but does not explain the hard core.

platform_answer: The 0.076 plateau is a shared, heavy-tailed hard-core problem: the worst 25% of molecules carry 69% of absolute error, 25% of molecules with unseen radius-2 local environments carry 50%, and all seven fixed checkpoints fail the same molecules. Seed disagreement is second-order. Global label shortage is not established, but finite sample/structure support remains unresolved; Null-grouping interface dilution is the hypothesis this round tests, not a confirmed main cause.

next_intervention.name: P3 dual-channel local/global composer (organized local channel + matched Null-local control)
next_intervention.base: P3 Null (413,505 params), recipe B, seed-0 train-only masked SSL
next_intervention.change: Add a parallel local composer on organized W_b=sum_{j touches b} w_j and V_b=sum w_j^2, then append sum(c_loc) and sum(c_loc^2) to the P3 reader; keep the original Null global path. New reader columns start at zero, so the initial output equals P3 within 1e-6.
next_intervention.control: Identical parameter count and initialization, but the local composer receives the Null grouping instead of organized ownership. The L-C contrast isolates local ownership from extra capacity.
next_intervention.primary_gate: L must beat historical P3B seed 0 by at least 0.003 MAE and beat the matched control C by at least 0.002 MAE; ordinary y>-3 must not degrade by more than 0.002.
next_intervention.stop_rule: Single seed only. If the gate fails, close the track; no seed 1, no width/radius/grouping grid, no follow-up feature sweep.
next_intervention.safety_gate: ordinary y>-3 delta vs P3B must not exceed +0.002; fixed P3B worst-100 absolute MAE must not worsen. Top-100 error share is descriptive only, not a hard gate.

label_curve.reason: The 3k/6k P3B curve would cost about 0.30 GPU-h and cannot distinguish the current alternatives cleanly: exact path content is already 99.6% covered and J does not help the rare subgroup. The decision is already between readout ownership and stopping, not between 10k and more labels.
label_curve.reconsider_if: A future audit finds that J improves the rare-environment subgroup but the overall loss is diluted by unrelated molecules; then a 3k/6k label curve would be informative.

budget.note: Two arms x seed 0 in parallel, 600 epochs, recipe B, plus 2-epoch timing/smoke. No seed 1 is affordable inside the hard cap.
